competition_rules_forfeit_scoreline.name: competition_rules_forfeit_scoreline
competition_rules_forfeit_scoreline.value:
forfeit_winner_goals >= 0 AND forfeit_loser_goals >= 0
          AND forfeit_winner_goals >= forfeit_loser_goals

fixtures_sides_distinct.name: fixtures_sides_distinct
fixtures_sides_distinct.value: home_entry_id IS NULL OR away_entry_id IS NULL OR home_entry_id <> away_entry_id

match_events_not_self.name: match_events_not_self
match_events_not_self.value: retracts_event_id IS NULL OR retracts_event_id <> id

match_events_minute_sane.name: match_events_minute_sane
match_events_minute_sane.value:
(minute IS NULL OR (minute >= 0 AND minute <= 200))
          AND (stoppage_minute IS NULL OR (stoppage_minute >= 0 AND stoppage_minute <= 60))

result_submissions_not_self.name: result_submissions_not_self
result_submissions_not_self.value: supersedes_id IS NULL OR supersedes_id <> id

result_submissions_scores_non_negative.name: result_submissions_scores_non_negative
result_submissions_scores_non_negative.value:
(home_score IS NULL OR home_score >= 0)
          AND (away_score IS NULL OR away_score >= 0)
          AND (home_penalties IS NULL OR home_penalties >= 0)
          AND (away_penalties IS NULL OR away_penalties >= 0)

venue_closures_window_ordered.name: venue_closures_window_ordered
venue_closures_window_ordered.value: ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at > starts_at

venues_parent_not_self.name: venues_parent_not_self
venues_parent_not_self.value: parent_venue_id IS NULL OR parent_venue_id <> id

venues_coordinates_in_range.name: venues_coordinates_in_range
venues_coordinates_in_range.value:
(latitude IS NULL OR (latitude >= -90 AND latitude <= 90))
          AND (longitude IS NULL OR (longitude >= -180 AND longitude <= 180))

standings_rows_counts_consistent.name: standings_rows_counts_consistent
standings_rows_counts_consistent.value:
played = won + drawn + lost
          AND won >= 0 AND drawn >= 0 AND lost >= 0
          AND goals_for >= 0 AND goals_against >= 0
          AND goal_difference = goals_for - goals_against
          AND points = points_earned + points_adjustment

entity_aliases_confidence_range.name: entity_aliases_confidence_range
entity_aliases_confidence_range.value: confidence IS NULL OR (confidence >= 0 AND confidence <= 1)
